youtube.baslik: Why can cleaning your ear make you cough? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Sensation in the ear canal skin comes from branches of the fifth, tenth and seventh cranial nerves. When the auricular branch of the tenth nerve is stimulated, some people cough while the ear is being cleaned.
youtube.kapanis_metni: Follow AIHEAR Audiology Academy for more quick facts.

instagram.kanca: Why can cleaning your ear make you cough?
bilgiler: Branches of cranial nerves V, X and VII supply the ear canal skin.
Stimulating the auricular branch of nerve X makes some people cough.
The thin skin of the bony canal is very sensitive to touch.
